dialogues.speaker: Notice Board
dialogues.text: I've had enough of this. The wooden Alpaca models I place always get knocked into all sorts of strange spots...

dialogues.speaker: Notice Board
dialogues.text: Could whoever it is just stop bopping them around!?

dialogues.speaker: Notice Board
dialogues.text: If I hadn't marked the placement spots out on the ground using graffiti, I'd have to look for them all over again...
